name: Contingency Plan
summary: Someone sends you to Ironforge to meet High Priestess Mims. Your next test is approaching, and she is waiting in the Mystic Ward.

sections.title: A Waiting Audience
sections.body: In Ironforge, High Priestess Mims is waiting to speak with you in the Mystic Ward. Your next test approaches, and the one who sent you cannot leave their place to witness your people's rites. The Light is wished upon your travels as you go to meet Mims.

faq.q: Who am I meant to meet?
faq.answer: High Priestess Mims is waiting to speak with you in Ironforge's Mystic Ward.
Mims should be in the Mystic Ward in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why am I going to Ironforge?
faq.answer: High Priestess Mims would speak with you there, and your next test is approaching.

faq.q: What does the sender say about my people's rites?
faq.answer: The sender wishes they could witness your people's rites, but says their place is where they are.

faq.q: What is wished for my travels?
faq.answer: The sender wishes the Light to accompany you on your travels.
